verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-definable event-to-action rule engine for Runpod. Auto-pay reloading the balance below a threshold is a single fixed billing behavior, and Flex workers scaling to zero when idle is built-in autoscaling. Both are adjacent features, not general rules a user can define to trigger arbitrary actions on events.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
